# ankra_cloudflare_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the DNS records in a Cloudflare zone, including records managed outside Ankra. The platform walks Cloudflare's pages for you up to a fixed bound; when a zone holds more records than that, `is_truncated` is `true` and a warning is shown, so narrow the listing with `name`, `record_type` or `search`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloudflare_dns_records" "mail" {
  zone_id         = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  credential_name = "cloudflare-main"
  record_type     = "MX"
}

output "mail_exchangers" {
  value = [for record in data.ankra_cloudflare_dns_records.mail.records : "${record.priority} ${record.content}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Cloudflare zone id, from `ankra_cloudflare_domains`.

### Optional

- `credential_name` (String) Cloudflare credential to list with. Unset uses the organisation's only Cloudflare credential.
- `name` (String) Only records with this exact FQDN.
- `record_type` (String) Only records of this type, such as `A` or `CNAME`.
- `search` (String) Only records whose name or content contains this text.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `is_truncated` (Boolean) Whether the platform stopped walking Cloudflare's pages before the end, so `records` is incomplete.
- `records` (Attributes List) Records in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Record comment.
- `content` (String) Record content.
- `id` (String) Cloudflare record id.
- `managed_by` (String) `ankra` for records Ankra created, `external` for the rest.
- `name` (String) Record FQDN.
- `priority` (Number) MX priority; null for other types.
- `proxiable` (Boolean) Whether the record can be proxied.
- `proxied` (Boolean) Whether Cloudflare proxies the record.
- `record_type` (String) Record type.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; `1` is automatic.
